conditions: Reranking must operate only on admitted candidates.

claims.statement: The reranker accepts bounded document batches and an exact expected model revision.
Reranker output is interpreted as ordering evidence over candidate indexes, not as new canonical objects.
Callers can bypass the reranker when it is unavailable, mismatched, or over budget.
